This App turn your device into a Magnetic Strength Meter (DC Gauss Meter).

DC magnetic fields can develop in many steel or iron objects if they have been exposed to magnetic fields, current, or friction. 

This App detects residual magnetism in steel parts quickly and accurately. Simply place the device edge near or against the object being tested, to have a reading representing the magnetism in the object at that site as well as polarity. Will also possible to verify thoroughness of de-magnetizing.
Check out your car, bed frame, desk furniture or any other metal objects you spend time with.
Can also be used to check the strength of magnets.

Features:
- Detect the strength of Magnetic force fields on all three axis’s (x,y,z)
- Switchable units: Tesla, Gauss
- 1 mG (0.1μT) Resolution

Applications:
- Assessment of magnetic materials. 
- Analysis of magnetic circuits and components 
- Measurement of residual magnetis 
- Measure stray and leakage fields 
- Measurement of absolute, and differential fields 
- Testing, sorting, classifying magnets 
- DC and AC motor testing 
- Relay and solenoid test 
- Loudspeaker test

Note: the measure is never 0 because there is the Earth's magnetic field

This app is build to make the hotair balloon load calculation as easy as possible for the pilot. The app contains a database of common hotairballoon components available on the market. In case you find missing components please let us know and we will add them to the app. This app is in the appstore for years now. It was recently completely rewritten in Swift to make it easier to maintain in the future. This app works best when you have a WIFI or a mobile network available. It will work offline but it that case more manual setups are required that would be automatic otherwise.

You can configure:
Persons on board
Cylinders
The envelope
Basket and burner
Meteo information
Temperature in celsius or fahrenheit
Weight in kg or pounds 
Tank volume in liters, US-gallons or UK-gallons
Envelope volume in cubic meters or cubic feet
Altitude in meters or feet
Envelope volumes in m3 and ft3

METAR info can be retrieved automatically for an given airfield to: 
Retrieve actual ground temperature
Determine actual field elevation *
Retrieve current QNH

All configuration data is kept locally on your iPhone.
Multiple balloon configurations can be stored.
Envelope volumes can be entered in cubic meters or in cubic feet x1000. The app determines automatically if cubic meters or cubic feet are used based on the entered value. For values greater than 1000, cubic meters are assumed, cubic feet (in thousands) for values less than 1000.

Note: When all automatic options are selected the following steps are taken to retrieve meteorological and field information:
Search for the nearest airport that provides a METAR report
Using the retrieved METAR get the QNH and temperature.
When your phone contains a barometer field elevation is determined
The retrieved values are then used to perform the load calculation

In some cases you may not want all options selected. If you are for example preparing your flight at noon you may want to enter the ground temperature manually because it will differ when you are flying in the evening.

This app was made by balloon pilots for balloon pilots. In case you are missing any cylinder, basket or burner types in the configuration list please supply information details of those to us and we will update the app. For questions or Recommendations please contact info@hotballoon.nl

The load calculation results can be send to any place, so they can be used for later reference, when your device has Email capabilities.

MQTT Loupe Pro is an intuitive utility to inspect and manage MQTT traffic exchanged on an MQTT broker. Connect to any public or local MQTT broker, subscribe to topics, view details of messages being transmitted and publish new messages to any topic.

Don't remember that one message or topic? Fire up the search to find it instantly using full-text search through all topics, and results updating live with new hits appearing as they arrive.

With built-in JSON highlighting for viewing and sending, this app is perfect for monitoring and managing Zigbee2Mqtt. Got frequently used topics that are further down the hierarchy? Make them favorites for easy and instant access.

Concerned about security? Let the server's certificate be validated before connecting; you don't have to allow insecure connections based on untrusted certificates. Need more? Provide a client certificate to authenticate yourself against the server.

All features in a nutshell:

- clean and simple interface
- hierarchical topic view
- sidebar with history of recently opened topics
- powerful full-text search capabilities across all topics and for a single message
- search results automatically update as new messages arrive
- extended message details, with proper formatting and syntax highlighting of JSON messages
- publish messages from within the app or with Siri Shortcuts
- topic auto-completion
- easily copy any topic or message value
- authentication with username/password or client certificates
- connect over MQTT or WebSocket protocol
- support for MQTT 3.1.1 and MQTT 5
- support for SSL/TLS, including SNI
- support for self-signed certificates
- full server certificate validation
- manage and connect multiple brokers at once
- full support for quality of service, for both subscribing and publishing

I built this simply but helpful speed dial app for my father. He kept getting lost in the phone app. Therefore, the user guidance is deliberately designed to be simple and catchy.

No confusing options, no "nifty" abbreviations of abbreviations.

Start SpeedDial, tap on a name and start the call.

My wife was so excited that SHE has been using SpeedDial very intensively since then.

Therefore, it is not only a support for elderly people who find it difficult to use modern user interfaces, but also and especially something for people who simply want to reach the 9 most important people in their lives with a fingertip.

SpeedDial only has two screen pages.

There are one to nine short dial entries on the main page. 

The entries automatically make the best possible use of the available space. They are colorfully designed so that they are more catchy.

You can set up the entries on the second page. 

You only need the names and the associated phone numbers.

If you do not want to use all of the nine possible entries, you simply leave the name slot empty. Entries without a name are not displayed on the main page. It's that easy...

... and the space saved will be used for the other entries, which then get more display space.

Supports VoiceOver.

Important: For security reasons, IOS does not allow any app to simply call a number. Therefore, a short question always appears when a phone call is intended. This can be answered immediately with a short tap. This security question is a very useful function and does not interfere.

Have fun.. and stay healthy ...
